chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim, from al-Hasan, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: Until when is there an 'umrah for the pilgrim? He said: Until dawn-time in the night of 'Arafah.

key_terms.السَّحَرِ: the pre-dawn time near the end of the night
key_terms.عُمْرَةٌ: the pilgrimage rite of 'umrah in this legal context
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ عَرَفَةَ: the night preceding the day of 'Arafah

ai.seo_question: Until when can a pilgrim perform the 'umrah of tamattu' before 'Arafah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal time limit for the pilgrim's 'umrah in the context of tamattu'. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that it remains valid until the pre-dawn time of the night of 'Arafah, making it a jurisprudential ruling related to hajj timing.
